title: GREAT little fan!
text: GREAT little fan!. This fan packs a punch!  I have had several different hand held fans, but this one blows the others away (pun intended 😊)!  When it’s on high it puts out quite a breeze! I just wish the battery charge lasted longer.  If you need a fan, look no further than this one!!

product_metadata.title: Mini Handheld Fan,New Semiconductor Refrigeration Hand Fan for Fast Cooling ,USB Rechargeable Fan Personal, Battery Operated 3 Speed Small Fan,Mini Size perfect for Kids,Home,Outdoor,Office,Travel
features: ✔【Cold Compress Function】The new handheld fan uses a semiconductor refrigeration material, 3s rapidly cooling. The unique cold compress functions can be iced into any part of your body (Away from hair). When you exercise and sweat, you can put the hand held fan against the face ice, quickly reduce the skin temperature, but also to eliminate edema.

✔【2 in 1 Handheld Fan & Desk Fan】In the subway station, you surely prefer have a handheld fan ​to relieve sweltering heat, no more embarrassment of sweating! And more, it comes with a lanyard that you can also hang around your neck. It is perfect for indoor and outdoor activities.

✔【3 Adjustable Speed Levels】This mini portable fan has 3 speed levels including low/medium/high speed. You can adjust the appropriate fan speed by pressing the power button. Let you feel comfortable and cool during the summer.

✔【USB Rechargeable】The usb fan has built-in 3000mAh batteries, long-lasting battery life. The package is configured for a USB charging cable and just 3 hours can enjoy a cool summer. You can charge it from a regular outlet, computer, or any other device via a USB port.

✔【Powerful Cooling & Ultra-high Speed】Portable handheld fan has built-in helical fan blades with a large inclination angle, which is powerful enough to stably drive the fan blades to run at high speed to generate strong wind.Low-speed 3800r/m, medium speed 4900r/m, high-speed 6000r/m, the wind is strong enough to cool you down quickly.

✔【Compact Design and Wide Application】The mini portable fan is 3.07*1.57*7.76 inches with a weight of 7.62 oz. Small sizes are convenient for travelling, commuting, working and any other outdoor activities, and can be placed inside the backpack stroller, with no space.
